intro.text: Wax's coachman, a small man who takes his job seriously even though Wax, a Coinshot, hardly needs a coach.

items.text: On the morning of Wax's wedding, Cob collected Wax and Wayne after the raid on Migs's gang and drove them to Ladrian mansion, where he was let off early with a broadsheet. Wax supposed he'd head off to the races for the day.
